title: Shield AI Reaches $28.8B Valuation Following $5.3B Acquisition of Echodyne
summary:
The defense technology company Shield AI is buying radar maker Echodyne in a deal valued at $5.3B to expand its Mission Systems business. To finance the acquisition and scale its operations, Shield AI is raising $2.5B in new capital, including a $1B Series H round that brings the startup's valuation to $28.8B.

The purchase adds software-defined radar technology and new manufacturing capacity to Shield AI's portfolio of counter-drone and security systems. The funding round was co-led by Disruptive Tech and Innovation X Capital, and included a structured equity investment from Blackstone as well as participation from Advent Intl and the Strategic Investment Group of JPMorganChase's Security and Resiliency Initiative.

Shield is acquiring Echodyne to expand our Mission Systems business with software-defined radars, engineering expertise and manufacturing capacity. 

The $5.3B transaction is supported by a $2.5B raise, including Series H funding at a $28.8B valuation, and will accelerate our efforts to meet growing demand for multi-mission capabilities. 

Echodyne’s industry-leading technology is used in hundreds of counter-drone and security systems worldwide, where it helps track drones, secure airspace, and protect people and infrastructure.
